entries.what: Catches the 6:48 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then heads to MWF classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Gets to campus on time and starts the day with the tracker on his mind.

entries.what: Between classes he cuts the spreadsheet from 81 rows down to 40 active targets, saying volume isn't working for him like it does for everyone else.
entries.outcome: Tracker is trimmed to 40 targets, quality over volume.

entries.what: Works a desk shift at the Bayshore career center, then rides home and spends the evening tailoring bullets for his top five targets.
entries.outcome: Five tailored applications queued up.

entries.what: Edits resume and lo-fi beats until nearly 2 a.m. in unit 132 while Marcus is out on shift.
entries.outcome: Resume bullets tightened; sleeps about five hours.

entries.what: Takes the 6:48 train and goes to Dr. Ashby's operations management class at 10:30.
entries.outcome: Takes notes on inventory models for the group project.

entries.what: Has his standing 3 p.m. mock interview with Lena at the career center, answering 'tell me about yourself' on his feet.
entries.outcome: Gets two notes on pacing and agrees to try again next week.

entries.what: Messages one alum on LinkedIn and works on the ops management tote-flow model at the library.
entries.outcome: One alum message sent; model half built.

entries.what: Makes dinner of leftover rajma and rice, then does a case team call about slides.
entries.outcome: Assigned the logistics cost section.

entries.what: MWF classes at Bayshore from 9 to 12 after the early train.
entries.outcome: Sits through a long lecture and catches up on notes.

entries.what: Works a career center desk shift and sees Omar chatting with a recruiter at an event table.
entries.outcome: Smiles through it and keeps working.

entries.what: Applies to three of the 40 targets that evening, tailoring each cover letter.
entries.outcome: Three applications sent.

entries.what: Takes the early train to Tuesday/Thursday ops management class, then stops by Dr. Ashby's 2 p.m. office hours to ask about the case comp.
entries.outcome: Ashby gives brief feedback on his approach and says to come prepared.

entries.what: Does laundry at the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room Thursday night and tapes up the next group project checklist.
entries.outcome: Clothes done; checklist drafted.

entries.what: Practices a few interview answers while folding clothes, a bit self-conscious about being overheard.
entries.outcome: Runs through one answer out loud.

entries.what: Rides the early train and sits through MWF classes; the Halloween candy bowl is out at the career center desk.
entries.outcome: Light day on campus.

entries.what: Back at Marisol Gardens, trick-or-treaters work the complex, and Arjun hands out candy from the doorway of unit 132 before the case team call.
entries.outcome: Runs out of candy by 7:30.

entries.what: Marcus leaves for his Ridgeline shift under mandatory overtime, and Arjun keeps the apartment quiet and finishes slides.
entries.outcome: Slides done by midnight.

entries.what: Runs the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about four miles, early Saturday.
entries.outcome: Finishes the loop and feels clear-headed.

entries.what: Goes to Ruiz Family Market for groceries and splits the receipt with Marcus.
entries.outcome: Stocks up on lentils, eggs and rice.

entries.what: Meets the case team at Bayshore for a practice session before Nov 8.
entries.outcome: Run-through goes better than expected; fixes two slides.

entries.what: Meal-preps rajma and rice, four containers, in the morning.
entries.outcome: Week's lunches ready.

entries.what: Has Sunday dinner at his parents' Pell Road house, picks up a tub of dal, and chats with Gurpreet about getting a CDL just in case.
entries.outcome: Leaves with the dal and Gurpreet's usual CDL question.

entries.what: Takes his mother's Sunday call about internships on the train ride back, telling her about the 40 targets.
entries.outcome: Mom approves of the focus.

entries.what: Late at night compares his LinkedIn headline line by line against the supply chain club president's.
entries.outcome: Rewrites his headline twice and doesn't post it.
